scope: validation sensitivity only, not an independent style/affect accuracy benchmark

training_protocol.parent_used: frozen TRAIN bootstrap only; absent from saved inference model
training_protocol.objective: complete observed reconstruction/geometry/state/class/event likelihood + posterior reconstruction/distribution KL,NLL + neutral content anchor + single-reference relation + execution/rollout mean

reference_protocol: one input reference per output; A and B are separate stability interventions
fixed_schedule_protocol: A conditioned affect and realized event schedule reused; only reference style changes
limitations: ARKit signs are proxies, not psychological or semantic emotion truth.
Reference response is not proof that the target personal style was transferred.
Same audio and seed may produce different schedules under changed conditioning.
No retraining, query-motion teacher, best-of-N selection, or test data used.
